sections.subhead: Build a Subscription Software Product Architected to Scale From Day One

body.text: Teknoppy builds SaaS products in Kochi - multi-tenant web platforms with subscription billing, onboarding and cloud hosting. Most MVPs launch in 8-14 weeks from Rs. 3,00,000, then grow in planned releases as you add customers.

Building a software product to sell requires architectural discipline that internal corporate tools never face. Multi-tenant database isolation, subscription lifecycle webhooks, self-service onboarding, and elastic cloud scaling must be architected from day one to avoid costly rewrites once paying customers subscribe.

items.title: Multi-Tenant Architecture & Data Isolation
items.html: Secure tenant-level isolation ensuring zero data cross-talk between customer organizations. We build on PostgreSQL schemas or isolated database clusters with automated tenant provisioning on sign-up.

items.title: MVP Product Scoping & Prototyping
items.html: We help founders define and build a lean, high-impact Minimum Viable Product in 8–14 weeks, validating product-market fit with paying customers before over-investing in complex edge features.

items.title: Subscription Billing & Automated Dunning
items.html: Seamless integration with Stripe Billing and Razorpay Subscriptions for recurring payments, tiered pricing plans, annual discounts, trial periods, and automated failed-payment dunning. See our Payment Gateway Integration.

items.title: Granular Roles & Team Permissions (RBAC)
items.html: Multi-tier role-based access control allowing tenant admins to invite team members, assign custom permission sets (Viewer, Editor, Admin), and enforce single sign-on (SSO) or 2FA.

items.title: Admin Console & Product Analytics
items.html: Super-admin dashboards tracking Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), subscriber churn, daily active users, and system health metrics. Explore our Dashboard Development Services.

items.title: Elastic Cloud DevOps & Automated Backups
items.html: Docker containerization deployed on AWS or Google Cloud, configured with auto-scaling groups, SSL termination, Redis caching, and automated daily off-site database backups.

items.title: 1. Product Strategy & MVP Scoping (Weeks 1-2)
items.text: We define core user personas, value metrics, essential MVP features, and defer non-critical features to future post-launch sprints.

items.title: 2. Multi-Tenant Architecture & Database Schema (Weeks 3-4)
items.text: We architect database tenancy models, API contracts, security boundaries, and cloud hosting infrastructure.

items.title: 3. UI/UX & Frictionless Onboarding Design (Weeks 5-6)
items.text: We craft intuitive user journeys and self-guided onboarding checklists that drive activation. See our Web App UI Design.

items.title: 4. Full-Stack Development & Billing Engine (Weeks 7-11)
items.text: Sprint-based development covering frontend applications, backend REST/GraphQL APIs, and subscription billing webhooks.

items.title: 5. Load Testing, Security Audit & Cloud Launch (Weeks 12-14)
items.text: Stress testing under high simulated concurrent loads, penetration testing, and production deployment with continuous monitoring.

items.title: 100% Code & Intellectual Property Ownership
items.text: You own the full source code, database architecture, and deployment pipelines outright. No vendor royalties or ongoing proprietary platform lock-in.

items.title: Strict Confidentiality (NDA on Request)
items.text: We sign a mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement before discussing your proprietary product logic, business model, or target market.

items.title: Modern Full-Stack Tech Stack
items.text: Built on React, Next.js, Node.js, Python (FastAPI), TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS/GCP — proven enterprise stacks that make hiring future in-house engineers effortless.

items.title: White-Label & Multi-Brand Architectures
items.text: Support for custom domains, tenant branding, custom color palettes, and white-label reseller capabilities built directly into the codebase.

sections.h2: Is SaaS the Right Model for Your Product?
sections.intro: This service is specifically designed for software products monetized on recurring models:

items.text: Founders and startups building a cloud software product to sell to businesses (B2B SaaS) or consumers (B2C SaaS).
Established businesses commercializing proven internal operational tools into independent software-as-a-service products.
Existing SaaS platforms needing to migrate from single-tenant legacy servers to a modern, scalable multi-tenant cloud architecture.

outro.html: For single-organization internal operational software, see our Software Development page. Need an investor-ready marketing website for your startup? Explore Web Design for Startups.

paragraphs.html: Teknoppy has engineered scalable cloud applications, customer portals, and multi-tenant platforms for clients across Kerala and the GCC. Our engineering prioritizes clean API modularity, high availability, and secure multi-tenancy. Explore our work on our Web Application Development and Portfolio pages.

paragraphs.text: SaaS investment is structured around product scope, billing complexity, and post-launch scaling milestones:

items.q: How much does it cost to build a SaaS MVP in Kochi?
items.a: A typical SaaS Minimum Viable Product (MVP) costs between ₹3,00,000 and ₹8,00,000 at Teknoppy, depending on user role complexity, multi-tenant database requirements, and subscription billing flows. Delivery takes 8 to 14 weeks.

items.q: What is multi-tenant architecture and why does it matter?
items.a: Multi-tenant architecture allows a single application deployment and codebase to serve thousands of separate customer accounts securely. Each customer's data is strictly partitioned. This dramatically lowers hosting costs and allows seamless platform-wide feature updates.

items.q: Will we own the software code and intellectual property?
items.a: Yes, 100%. Upon project completion, all source code, database architecture, API designs, and cloud infrastructure accounts belong entirely to your company. We sign a formal Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before requirements discovery.

items.q: What makes SaaS development different from regular software development?
items.a: SaaS products require self-service onboarding, recurring subscription billing, elastic cloud scaling, and strict multi-tenant security from day one — features that single-business internal tools rarely need.

items.q: Do you handle subscription billing and payment gateways?
items.a: Yes. We configure automated recurring billing via Stripe Billing or Razorpay Subscriptions, supporting free trials, credit card payments, international multi-currency checkouts, and automatic invoice generation.

items.q: Can the SaaS platform scale as our user base grows?
items.a: Yes. By containerizing services with Docker and deploying on auto-scaling cloud infrastructure (AWS or Google Cloud), the platform automatically provisions additional computing capacity during peak user traffic.
